title: A Systematic Review of the Effects of Different Resistance Training Volumes on Muscle Hypertrophy
population: Randomized trials in men aged 18 to 35 with at least one year of resistance training experience.
key_findings: Volumes were grouped as low (under 12 weekly sets), moderate (12 to 20) and high (over 20).
Moderate and high volumes gave similar growth for the quadriceps and the biceps; high volume gave more growth for the triceps.
The authors suggest 12 to 20 weekly sets per muscle group as a general starting recommendation for young trained men.
methods: Systematic review with a quantitative synthesis of six of seven included randomized trials lasting at least six weeks, using direct measures of muscle thickness or cross-sectional area.
limitations: Seven studies, of which six were pooled; young trained men only; three muscles analysed; the suggested range is the authors' reading of these few studies.

verification.retraction_check: No retraction or correction notice in Crossref updated-by or in the PubMed publication types on 2026-11-25.
